description: This source file defines timer management functionality for the Orleans framework, including interfaces and classes for managing timers, scheduling, and executing timer callbacks within the Orleans runtime. It includes internal implementations for delayed execution ('DelayTimer') and a static generic TimerManager for per-thread timer queues, firing timers upon expiration or cancellation.

classes.name: ITimerManager
classes.description: Interface providing delay functionality for timers, allowing registration of delays with cancellation tokens.

classes.name: TimerManagerImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation of ITimerManager that delegates to the static TimerManager.

classes.name: TimerManager
classes.description: Static class managing timer scheduling and execution, supporting delayed timers, with thread-local queues for scalability.

classes.name: DelayTimer
classes.description: Internal class implementing ITimerCallback representing a scheduled delay, with completion handling and due time/cancellation properties.

classes.name: ITimerCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects used by timers that define actions on timeout or cancellation.

classes.name: ILinkedList
classes.description: Generic interface representing a linked list structure for timer elements.

classes.name: ILinkedListElement
classes.description: Interface for elements in a linked list, supporting a Next property.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: Static helper class providing linked list operations such as add tail and remove.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Creates a delay timer for the specified timespan.

methods.name: DelayUntil
methods.description: Creates a delay timer until a specified absolute UTC time.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a timer with the TimerManager, scheduling it for execution.
